rules.title: California Tenant Protection Act of 2019 (AB 1482) - Rent Increase Cap
rules.requirement: Landlords of covered rental properties cannot raise rent by more than 5% plus local cost-of-living increase, or 10%, whichever is lower, in a 12-month period.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential real property/dwelling units, excluding mobilehome homeowners; subject to building age and other exemptions.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply to a homeowner of a mobilehome as defined in Section 798.9; units constructed within last 15 years on a rolling basis; deed-restricted affordable housing; certain dormitories.
rules.penalty: Civil liability including injunctive relief, damages equal to overpayment, attorney's fees/costs, and treble damages for willful/oppressive/fraudulent/malicious violations; AG or city attorney/county counsel may enforce and seek injunctive relief.
rules.quoted_span: This section shall apply to all rent increases subject to subdivision (a) occurring on or after March 15, 2019, except as provided in subdivision (i).

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is subsidized/deed-restricted affordable housing or a dormitory

rules.conflict_note: This passage describes effective dates for the 2019 version; a later amendment appears to use a 2021 applicability date (February 18, 2021) in P2, suggesting the statute was amended with a new baseline period; both dates are referenced in the chunk.

rules.title: California Tenant Protection Act - Rent Increase Cap (amended provisions referencing 2021 baseline)
rules.requirement: For rent increases between February 18, 2021 and January 1, 2022, the applicable rent baseline and catch-up increase rules apply under the same 5%+CPI/10% cap.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential real property subject to subdivision (a); baseline rent calculations for increases occurring in this window.
rules.penalty: Civil liability including injunctive relief, damages equal to overpayment, attorney's fees/costs, and treble damages for willful/oppressive/fraudulent/malicious violations.
rules.quoted_span: The applicable rent on January 1, 2022, shall be the rent as of February 18, 2021, plus the maximum permissible increase under subdivision (a).
rules.conflict_note: This passage provides a different baseline date (February 18, 2021) than the earlier provision referencing March 15, 2019 (see P6); unclear if this is a separate amendment year's catch-up provision within the same statute rather than a conflicting effective date.
